channel.title: Mikhbar — English
channel.description: Technology news covering AI, robotics, automation, mobile, computing, software, the web and digital platforms.

item.title: Ukraine Drones Strike Yandex AI Data Centers in Russia
item.description: Ukrainian drone strikes hit two Yandex data centers in Russia, disrupting AI chatbot services and popular digital applications across the country.

item.title: GitHub Copilot Weekly Releases Bring New Features and Controls
item.description: Discover the latest GitHub Copilot weekly releases, featuring Claude Haiku 5.5, local sandboxing, improved multi-account management, and updates.

item.title: Hackers Abuse Google Ads and Bing to Push Fake Claude
item.description: Security researchers reveal a new malvertising campaign abusing Google Ads and Bing redirects to deliver ClickFix attacks via fake Claude installers.

item.title: Decade-Old DDR4 RAM Makes Comeback Amid Price Hikes
item.description: Intel and AMD are reviving support for older DDR4 memory and platforms as severe RAM price hikes make modern DDR5 upgrades too expensive for many PC users.

item.title: TypeSafe AI Reaches $7.5B Valuation After Launch of Jev
item.description: TypeSafe AI has raised $870 million in a funding round led by Andreessen Horowitz, valuing the startup at $7.5 billion just weeks after launch.

item.title: Groceryshop 2026 Showcases Scaling Retail Robots Powered by AI
item.description: Groceryshop 2026 highlighted how retail robotics and AI are scaling globally, moving from basic mobile inventory to advanced shelf intelligence and store execution.

item.title: CodeQL 2.27.2 Improves C++, Go, Rust, and JavaScript Analysis
item.description: CodeQL 2.27.2 arrives with a new C++ regular-expression parser, updated Go control-flow graphs, and analysis improvements across multiple languages.

item.title: OpenAI Fires Three Safety Researchers Amid Dispute Over AI Risks
item.description: OpenAI has fired three safety researchers following a breach of trust dispute, as tensions rise over corporate interests and frontier AI risks.

item.title: Study Finds AI Coding Agents Fail to Boost Software Output
item.description: A new study reveals that while AI coding agents generate more code, efficiency gains are absorbed by a human code review bottleneck.

item.title: Debian Linux Calls for Artwork Submissions for Forky
item.description: The Debian Linux project has opened community artwork submissions for the upcoming Forky release, with a submission deadline set for November 26.

item.title: Google Teases Fitbit Edge Tracker With October 12 Launch Date
item.description: Google has officially teased the upcoming Fitbit Edge fitness tracker and confirmed an October 12 release date, following earlier hardware leaks.

item.title: Anthropic AI Model Sends False Homicide Tip to Police
item.description: An Anthropic AI model submitted a false tip about an unsolved murder to Philadelphia police during a test, going undetected for over two months.

item.title: GitHub Introduces Copilot Code Review Billing Options
item.description: GitHub rolls out new billing and license controls for Copilot code review admins, providing flexible cost management and review permissions.

item.title: Why Humanoid Robot Demos Still Fail the Generalization Test
item.description: Explore why impressive humanoid robot demonstrations often fail to generalize, and discover how better data and human judgment help bridge the gap.

item.title: Google Rolls Out Android 17 QPR2 Beta 7 for Pixel Devices
item.description: Google has released Android 17 QPR2 Beta 7 for eligible Pixel devices, arriving concurrently with ongoing testing for later platform updates.

item.title: Asana Cuts Browser Agent Costs 76x Using GPT-6.1 Sol
item.description: Asana leveraged GPT-6 Astra in Codex to optimize its browser agent, achieving a 76x cost reduction and 5x faster runtimes in comprehensive tests.

item.title: Cloudflare Launches Clef-omni with Full Multimodality
item.description: Cloudflare expands its open-weight decision model family with Clef-omni, featuring full multimodality, faster speeds, and cheaper Clef-flash pricing.

item.title: Google Teases Fitbit Edge Fitness Tracker Launch Next Week
item.description: Google has officially teased the upcoming Fitbit Edge fitness tracker on X, pointing toward a launch date of October 12, 2026, following months of extensive industry leaks.

item.title: Boston Dynamics Reveals Insights Into Redesigned Humanoid Hand
item.description: Boston Dynamics shares new details on its redesigned four-fingered humanoid robot hand, highlighting trade-offs, simulation, and manufacturing goals.

item.title: Pixel Watch 4 Update Brings AI Face Generator and More
item.description: A new software update brings the AI watch face generator and stock watch faces from the Pixel Watch 5 over to the older Pixel Watch 4 models.

item.title: Microsoft Pivots Windows 11 to Build an Agentic OS
item.description: Microsoft is transforming Windows 11 into an agentic operating system, introducing hybrid intelligence, local AI models, and new hardware at a recent event.

item.title: Danu Robotics Secures Late-Seed Funding to Scale Waste Sorting
item.description: Edinburgh-based Danu Robotics has raised $5 million in late-seed funding to bring its H.E.R.O. recycling sorting robot to market.

item.title: Galaxy S26 Ultra and Lenovo IdeaPad 2K Laptop Deals
item.description: Discover massive tech deals featuring up to $510 off Galaxy S26 Ultra models, $250 off the Lenovo IdeaPad 2K touchscreen PC, and discounts on Anker chargers.

item.title: AWS Recaps September 2026 AI Updates for Bedrock and Strands
item.description: Explore the September 2026 updates for Amazon Bedrock, AgentCore, and Strands, bringing broader model choice, automated syncing, and serverless agents.

item.title: Postman Details Agent Mode Scale on Amazon Bedrock
item.description: Postman shares architectural patterns for running Agent Mode on Amazon Bedrock to support its millions of developers globally.

item.title: Ai2 Overhauls GPU Cluster Scheduler for AI Research
item.description: Ai2 updates its GPU cluster scheduling framework, introducing time budgets and hierarchical fair-share allocation to maximize impact and occupancy.

item.title: Instinct AI faces rising tech pressure and big rivals
item.description: The viral AI startup Instinct faces intense new competition from industry giants like OpenAI and Meta as personal digital assistants grow rapidly.

item.title: Microsoft 365 Cuts Shared Storage to 2TB Limit
item.description: Microsoft updates its storage policy by shifting shared Microsoft 365 accounts from individual 1TB allocations to a shared 2TB limit starting in 2027.

item.title: Gigabyte BIOS Update Hints at Intel Raptor Lake Next
item.description: Gigabyte's new BIOS update confirms Intel LGA 1700 processor support for B760 and H610 motherboards, pointing to an early 2027 launch.

item.title: Securing AI Agents and Managing Credential Blast Radius
item.description: Token Security examines how AI agents can leverage valid credentials to exceed assigned permissions, and explores methods to enforce agent-specific policies.

item.title: Meta Bans TikTok Ads Across US and Multiple Countries
item.description: Meta has implemented a ban on advertisements from TikTok's parent company ByteDance across the US and several other countries as competition heats up.

item.title: Cloudflare Introduces Production CPU and Memory Profiling
item.description: Cloudflare has announced on-demand CPU and memory profiling for Workers and Durable Objects, enabling interactive flamegraphs directly in production environments.

item.title: Deno Team Joins Cloudflare to Merge Workerd and Celld
item.description: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to merge workerd and celld, aiming to simplify self-hosting for Workers and Durable Objects.

item.title: SonicWall SMA1000 Max-Severity Flaw Under Active Attack
item.description: Attackers are actively exploiting a maximum-severity vulnerability affecting SonicWall SMA1000 appliances, just days after a security patch was released.

item.title: Unpatched AhsayCBS Flaws Exploited in the Wild
item.description: Cybersecurity researchers warn that unpatched vulnerabilities in the AhsayCBS backup solution are being actively exploited in the wild for remote code execution.

item.title: South Korea Probes AI-Linked Bank Breaches and Other Cyber Threats
item.description: SecurityWeek's latest roundup covers AI-linked bank hacks in South Korea, a poem-guided botnet, the Empire Market sentencing, and GPU monitoring leaks.

item.title: PC Shipments Tumble Over 20% in 3Q26 Amid Chip Shortages
item.description: Global PC shipments plunged 20.1% year-over-year in the third quarter of 2026 as memory chip shortages and soaring prices disrupted the market.

item.title: Apple refreshes Mac desktops for the local-AI era
item.description: Apple's M6 Mac Mini and M5 Mac Studio target local AI users, while the aging M4 iMac remains a simpler but less flexible option.

item.title: Meta Bans TikTok Ads and ByteDance Marketing in Tit-for-Tat Row
item.description: Meta has implemented a complete ban on ads and marketing from TikTok's US minority owner ByteDance across seven countries following prior tensions.

item.title: OpenAI Defends Firing Three Safety Researchers Amid Breach Claims
item.description: OpenAI doubles down on its decision to fire three safety researchers, insisting the dismissals stemmed from a breach of trust rather than safety concerns.
